a.text: The sensor recorded 18 degrees at noon.

b.text: We should replace this sensor before the next trial.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: A reported observation does not gain assert merely by being declarative; the second sentence advances a recommendation.

a.text: The report concludes that the subsidy caused the increase.

b.text: Taking those results together, I think the subsidy caused the increase.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: The first attributes an existing inference; the second makes one. A conclusion is not automatically reporting because its inputs are observations.

near_boundary.reason: Could be a reported result, new inference or foregrounded hypothesis; recover provenance and surrounding reasoning.

a.text: The queue grows because requests arrive faster than the server completes them.

b.text: The growing queue suggests that our staffing plan will miss its service target.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: A connecting dependency versus a consequence inferred for a plan. Explanation does not require a long mechanism.

near_boundary.text: The queue will grow, so the plan is inadequate.
near_boundary.reason: A consequence and evaluation without an explanation of how the queue grows; assert needs a separately justified stance job.

a.text: An urgent request requires a response within two working hours.

b.text: A request to restore a failed payment service is one example of an urgent request.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: Meaning criterion versus an instance offered for an already named idea.

near_boundary.text: Here, an urgent request means either a service outage or an active security incident.
near_boundary.reason: An explicit extensional definition; full theoretical completeness is unnecessary.

a.text: Nguyen uses the term adaptive scheduling in her 2014 paper.

b.text: Nguyen found fewer missed deadlines after the change; that result is one reason to try adaptive scheduling.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: A source mention does not supply a supporting relation. In B the observation, supported trial recommendation and reason link are identifiable; evidence quality is unassessed.

a.text: Imagine a customer leaving after a third error message; this is the frustration I mean.

b.text: The claim says every even integer is divisible by four. Consider six: it is even and is not divisible by four, so the universal claim fails.

synthetic_contrasts.decision_to_test: A constructed or conceptual case can support a logical counterexample; neither example supplies an observed customer rate.

near_boundary.reason: The author offers the invented case as support; its empirical inference is unwarranted. Rhetorical use and evidential adequacy are separate.
